title: entitopia pipelines envelope
description: Envelope only. `processors` is Elasticsearch's own ingest DSL — owned elsewhere, moving independently, and already rejected loudly by the cluster when wrong, which this repo made fatal. A schema over its interior would go stale, start rejecting valid config, and teach operators that a validation failure is something to work around.

name.description: Pipeline id. An index-config's `pipeline` key must name one of these.

processors.description: Elasticsearch ingest processors, passed through untouched. An empty list would create a pipeline that silently does nothing, which is why minItems is 1.
